name: session_read
description: Read another session's context (read-only). Default digest mode shows a header (title, first prompt, message count, checkpoints) plus the most recent messages; raw mode renders messages only. Sessions are identified by their id from session_list.

session_id.description: Session id (from session_list), 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

mode.description: digest (default): header + recent messages; raw: messages only.

limit.description: Number of most recent messages to show (default 20 for digest, 60 for raw; max 200).
